_note: Sample events. Chances, resource costs and effect magnitudes are approximate game-balance placeholders. Effects are keyed by engine stat or resource name and applied as deltas.

items.title: Dust on the Solar Array
items.description: After yesterday's EVA, fine regolith is clinging to the panels. Array output is down and the lunar night is coming.

options.label: Send two crew out to brush the panels
options.explanation: Lunar dust is electrostatically charged and sticks to surfaces; it is abrasive and hard to remove, so brushing works but costs EVA time and suit wear.

options.label: Leave it and ration power through the night
options.explanation: No EVA risk, but the array stays dirty, so battery charge going into the 14-day night is lower than planned.

items.title: Antenna Pointing Drift
items.description: Thermal flexing has pushed the high-gain antenna off its Earth lock. Data rate is dropping and the next science downlink is due.

options.label: Recalibrate pointing using a star tracker fix
options.explanation: A narrow high-gain beam must point within a fraction of a degree of Earth; a star tracker gives an absolute attitude reference to re-aim it.

options.label: Fall back to the low-gain antenna
options.explanation: A wide low-gain beam does not need precise pointing but carries far less data, so science downlink slows down.
